products.title: Blue Print to Beginner: Intermediate Leglocks by Tom DeBlass
products.body:
Attack The Lower Body With Highly Effective Submission Locks, Taught By One Of Grappling’s Most In-Demand Instructors - Tom DeBlass
  • Master useful moves like the achilles lock, the heel hook, estima lock, and more as Tom explains how you can set up submission offense below the lower body
  • Tom DeBlass is a Renzo Gracie black belt who has spent years training with, learning from, and training some of the best grapplers and instructors in all of Brazilian jiu-jitsu - including Gordon Ryan, Garry Tonon, and more
  • Set up your attacks from common grappling positions like the butterfly guard, closed guard, half guard, and more as Tom shares how to learn faster and cut through the mistakes easier
  • Tom has used some of these same submissions in his successful competition career - highlighted by his three ADCC Trials Championships!
  • Learn the intricacies of the heel hook - both inside and outside - as Tom shares all you need to know about how to apply these devastating holds as safely and successfully as possible
  • Get creative with transitions into calf slicers, waiter positions, kneebar rolls, and more on this 4 part series

  • BELLY-DOWN ACHILLES/ACHILLES TRANSITION TO OUTSIDE HEEL HOOK

  • DYNAMICS OF THE OUTSIDE HEEL HOOK

    • PART 2

  • OUTSIDE HEEL HOOK FROM THE HALF-GUARD BACK TAKE WHEN THE PARTNER DEFENDS BY ROLLING OUT

  • TOP HALF-GUARD STEP-BACK LEG LACE TO INVERSION/KNEEBAR/TOE HOLD
  • ESTIMA LOCK
  • HALF-GUARD STEP THE LEG OVER FALLING TO BOTH SIDES ATTACKING BOTH TOP AND BOTTOM LEGS EXPOSING TOEHOLDS AND KNEE BARS
  • CALF SLICER FROM THE TOP HALF-GUARD AND BUTTERFLY GUARRD TRAPPING THE TOP LEG AND THE BOTTOM LEG/DECEIVING WITH THE LEG WEAVE

    • PART 3

  • HEEL HOOK FROM BUTTERFLY GUARD SLOWING DOWN THE ROLL WITH THE FAR FOOT
  • STOPPING THE LEG DRAG WITH THE INVERTED HEEL HOOK/KNEEBAR
  • FAR-SIDE BUTTERFLY HOOK TO THE SAME SIDE LEG LOCK
  • SEATED GUARD INSIDE-CONTROL DRILL OPENING UP AND SHUTTING DOWN THE LEG LOCK
  • CLOSED-GUARD UNDERHOOKING THE LEG INTO MULTIPLE LEG ATTACKS

    • PART 4

  • CLOSED-GUARD OMOPLATA TO LEG LOCK SETUP
  • HALF-GUARD SETUP TO THE LEG LOCK
  • WAITER SWEEP TRANSITION TO THE HEEL HOOK
  • X-GUARD SWITCH TO CALF SLICER/BEAR TRAP
  • KNEE LEVER TO LEG ATTACK

products.title: The Lockdown Blueprint by Tom DeBlass
products.body:
Grappling guru Tom DeBlass shows his entire arsenal from the lockdown half guard position on this 4-volume series.

  • Control and slow down bigger, stronger, athletic opponents (even in no-gi) with these tips for creating the tightest entanglements
  • Use the lockdown to create powerful attacks like the electric chair, waiter sweep, heel hook entries, back takes, and more
  • Learn how to get to lockdown from common half guard positions, butterfly guard, and other traditional no-gi guards
  • Break down how to escape the lockdown from top position, so you don’t get caught up here again


Lock Down The Opposition and Attack With Powerful No-Gi Techniques With This Powerful Half Guard System From Grappling Legend Tom DeBlass

The 3-Time ADCC Trials Champion Shows How To Use This Creative Half Guard To Sweep, Submit, Take The Back, Enter Leg Locks, and More!

Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

Tom DeBlass is back with BJJ Fanatics to take you through a masterclass of one of grappling’s most effective half guards, the lockdown. Tom breaks down how to tighten up this no-gi half guard position and how to attack for incredible sweeps, submissions, and more on this 4-volume instructional series. With some of Tom’s favorite combinations, soon you’ll be using the lockdown for huge half guard success, even against faster, stronger opponents.

Enter into the lockdown from the traditional half guard and start giving yourself a tighter control over the opposition and slow them down long enough for you to start using Tom’s best attacks to sweep and submit. Get people moving all over with electric chair and waiter sweeps, enter into outside heel hooks and calf slicers, and get to the back where you can begin choking.

Included in Tom’s breakdown of how to sweep and submit from bottom position, Tom also shows some of his concepts for clearing out lockdowns from top, so you can understand the move fully. Use this step-by-step instruction to clearly lay out all your possibilities with key details for success on Tom’s new 4-volume instructional series.

﻿Reverse Lockdown Escape

What Exactly Do You Get?

Part 1:

  • Intro + Entry To Lockdown
  • Lockdown 
  • Underhook To Electric Chair 
  • Lockdown To Outside Heel Hook 
  • Lockdown Reversal #1 
  • Taking Them Back 
  • Lockdown Reversal #2
  • Pushing Them Forward 
  • Lockdown To Calf Slicer 
  • Entering The Back From Lockdown Position
  • 1 Nearside Grip
  • 2 Farside Grip
  • 3 Lower Leg Manipulation 

Part 2:

  • Lockdown Recovery From Underhooks Into A Modified Knee Lever
  • Framing To Lockdown To Deep Half Guard Entry Into Reversal 
  • Lockdown To Deep Half Guard To Toehold
  • Lockdown To Same Leg Kneebar
  • Nearside Knee Trap/Torque To Reversal 
  • Reverse Lockdown Entry

Part 3:

  • Lower Leg Elevation To Nearside Shin Grab/knee Lever
  • Using Reverse Lockdown To Set Up The Waiter Sweep
  • Settings Up Lockdown From Butterfly Guard 
  • Lockdown Escape #1
  • Windshield Wipe, Hips Low/Step Back Into Leglock
  • Reverse Lockdown Escape 

Part 4:

  • Escaping The Lockdown, When Opponent Locks Hands To Your Far Leg, Using Shoulder Pressure
  • Escaping Deep Half Guard Lockdown With Step Back To Kneebar 
  • Electric Chair Escape Using Hand Attacks/Body Leverage And Proper Angles 
  • Using Lockdown From Back Control 
  • Switching The Lockdown, Catching The Arm When The Opponent Hops To The Other Side From The Back 
  • Closing Thoughts

products.title: Leg Attack Domination by Tom DeBlass
products.body:
Leg Attack Domination-Tom DeBlass

  • Tom DeBlass is here to help you DOMINATE leg locks
  • Tom DeBlass is a 3X ADCC Veteran, UFC and Bellator MMA veteran and is the man who gave submission ace Garry Tonon his black belt. He has also been instrumental in the superstar rise of The King Gordon Ryan
  • Tom DeBlass is one of the most influential grapplers in the world today. People flock to his seminars around the world because of his amazing ability to break down techniques in a way that allows grapplers of all levels to benefit and implement the techniques immediately
  • If you are new to leg locks, this is the place to start. If you THINK you know leg locks, you still need this DVD to help you DOMINATE. Tom DeBlass takes all of the mystery out of the the dark art of leg submissions and will have you DOMINATING lower limbs and the mats in record time
  • Know More. Win More.


Leg Attack Domination-Tom DeBlass

One of BJJ Fanatics Best-Seller and World Renowned BJJ Coach and Competitor, Tom DeBlass is Here to Show You His Very Own Leg Attack System

Butterfly Guard to Knee Bar by Tom DeBlass:

What Will You Learn?

Tom DeBlass’ jiu jitsu style is a perfect mix of old school and new school techniques.  His skills were forged in the early days of Team Renzo Gracie with icons like Renzo himself, brothers Ralph and Ryan, and his primary instructor Ricardo Almeida.  Tom DeBlass’ development didn’t end there. He has spend the last decade sharpening those tools alongside sub only killers Garry Tonon and Gordon Ryan who are the cornerstones of the legendary Danaher Death Squad.

Even though leg locks continue to grow in popularity, many practitioners are still confused about where to start.  What is legal and what is not? What if I’m new to No Gi? Tom DeBlass is here to take you through all of his favorite foot attacks, from Achilles locks, to knee bars, and toe holds in a way that is easy for ANYONE to begin applying right away and start DOMINATING!

Leg Attack Domination is not just a series of techniques from static positions.  Tom DeBlass is going to show you all of his favorite entries to the leg attacks and show you ALL of the options you have once you are there.  No one can get you from watching the DVD to DOMINATING the mats faster than Tom DeBlass!

So What’s on this series?

In the four volumes of Leg Attack Domination, Tom DeBlass is going to give you everything he knows about straight ankle locks, kneebars, and toe holds and then show you all of his successful, battle-tested entries to get to those positions and DOMINATE the submission.

Tom DeBlass is well known for his Half Guard prowess and in this series you are going to see all of these leg attacks shown from half guard, butterfly half guard, and deep half guard.  He is going to show you how to DOMINATE leg attacks during back takes, turtle attacks and even show you the most effective way to use other submission attacks to set up a DOMINATING leg finish.

There is no room for filler on this series.  Tom DeBlass is well known for being a straight shooter and in this series, you’re getting ALL of his favorite leg attacks in the most clear, easy to follow way that will have you going straight from your computer to the mats and have you DOMINATING Leg Attacks immediately.

So what exactly do you get?

In this four volume series you are going to get Tom DeBlass’ formula for Leg Attack Domination.  His straight shooting, no nonsense approach will give you all of the legal for competition leg attack knowledge you need, whether you are brand new to lower body submissions or need some new tools for your game.  Another great thing about Tom DeBlass’ instruction is that while the techniques shown are No Gi, the majority of the techniques work equally well in Gi jiu jitsu.

Volume 1:

Attacking legs from the Top

Volume 2:

Volume 3:

Butterfly half guard knee bar/toe hold/calf slice 

Achilles defense to achilles lock

Neutral ashi attacks

Volume 4:

Offensive turtle leg attacks 

Leg attacks from de la riva 

Bottom De La Riva leg attacks 

Achilles Control 

Half Guard Omoplata to Achilles/Knee Bar 

Kimura to Leg Attacks 

Outro

Shutting Down the Berimbolo with Leg Attacks with Tom DeBlass:

So What Does It Cost?

Tom DeBlass is easily one of the most well known and influential grapplers of all time.  He has had a long career as a IBJJF World Champion, ADCC, UFC and Bellator MMA veteran. He is one of the most sought after instructors around the world known for his clear, no BS approach to instruction.  Now you can learn ALL of Tom DeBlass’ favorite LEG ATTACKS. The techniques on these dvds do not require any crazy athleticism, but they will require great skill from your opponents to escape them.
